{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "indexes",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Touches src/index/*, extracts block filter index lifecycle helpers into node/indexes, and removes global index pointers (g_txindex, g_txospenderindex, g_coin_stats_index, g_filter_indexes).",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Encapsulating index ownership within NodeContext decouples the indexing framework from process-global state. The change removes static global pointers (`g_txindex`, `g_filter_indexes`, etc.) and isolates block filter registry helpers, which improves encapsulation and unblocks multiprocess architectural work without affecting indexing runtime behavior."
    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches net_processing.cpp and net_processing.h solely to pass index lookup via a PeerManager::Options callback rather than global state.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Edits to net_processing are mechanical caller adjustments to consume index lookups through PeerManager options instead of global variables."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "RPC and REST files are modified only to access index instances via NodeContext instead of global pointers.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Edits across RPC and REST endpoints are mechanical updates following the removal of global index variables."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches test setup utilities and unit tests purely to adapt them to NodeContext-scoped index ownership.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Test modifications are follow-ups to index API signature changes rather than test framework improvements."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Init changes are limited to constructing and destroying indexes within NodeContext.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The init.cpp changes simply wire up index lifecycle within node initialization rather than modifying shared utility primitives."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Addresses optional secondary indexes under src/index/ rather than consensus or the UTXO database.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The PR strictly affects secondary optional indexes (txindex, coinstatsindex, blockfilterindex) and does not alter chainstate, UTXO, or block validation logic."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/wallet/test/wallet_tests.cpp only to update index access in tests.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The single wallet test modification is a mechanical follow-up to initialize index state via NodeContext."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 0,

  }
